Kavya discussed Diwali, Pongal, and Makar Sankranti traditions.
Kavya identified that crops are cut when ready but did not link harvest festivals to that season.
Kavya repeatedly said festival dates are random and mixed up sowing with harvesting.
Kavya did not pass the teach-back on linking harvest festivals with crop readiness and seasons.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting harvest festivals with the time when crops are ready, using Pongal and Makar Sankranti as examples. Kavya described Diwali traditions clearly and named Pongal ingredients, but mixed up sowing and harvesting and continued to say festival dates are random; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, you can ask Kavya to sort examples into “seeds being sown” and “crops ready to harvest,” then connect Pongal or Makar Sankranti with the harvest group.
